outputs.summary: Implemented Issue #6: refactored Snapshot and Artifact models to make Artifact an independent first-class entity. Added Artifact interface and ArtifactRow type, workspace_artifacts database table, CRUD queries (insertArtifact, getArtifactById, listArtifactsByWorkspace, listArtifactsBySnapshot), updated snapshot creation to store metadata and diff content as Artifact rows, and added CLI artifact command with list and show subcommands supporting --json output. Build validated with npm run check (typecheck + build + smoke test all pass).
